title: Artifact for Structured State Interfaces for Access-Control Verifier Replay in Defensive LLM Security Agents
description:
Sanitized replay-fixture artifact for a defensive LLM security-agent study.
The artifact contains redacted access-control verifier-replay fixtures, summary
JSON files, result-to-claim mapping, leakage audit reports, and an offline
validator that recomputes the manuscript-level paired contrasts without external
model calls or benchmark services. The artifact does not contain live targets,
credentials, operational exploit commands, network addresses, or target-specific
reproduction procedures.
notes: For double-blind review, replace anonymous creator metadata only after the review policy allows de-anonymization. If Zenodo's public DOI would break anonymity, use an anonymous OSF view or journal artifact-review service during review and publish the DOI after acceptance.
